title: SpaceX Inspiration4 Blood Serum Metabolic Panel and Immune/Cardiac Cytokine Arrays (Comprehensive Metabolic Panel and Multiplex)
mission: SpaceX Inspiration4 (3-day Low Earth Orbit mission, Sept 2021)
iss_medbay_module: Bio-Scanner Bed & Vascular Echo / Ultrasound Station
assays: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP - Beckman Coulter AU5800)
Human Cardiovascular Disease Panel 3 9-Plex Discovery Assay (HDCVD9)

protocols.sample_collection: Serum separator tubes (SSTs), centrifuged at 1300xg for 10 min; fresh serum analyzed for CMP, remaining frozen at -80C.
protocols.normalization: Normalized by average of pre-flight baseline values across crew (n=4).

diagnostic_explanation: Acute cephalad fluid shift and microgravity stress elevate systemic inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-alpha) and transient metabolic/cardiovascular biomarkers during initial orbital adaptation.
